descriptions.normal: A spicy meat stew. Raw meat is seasoned with an array of different spices, then slow-cooked until tender. The moment you open the lid, a hot and spicy aroma wafts out to greet you. When you're not sure what to eat when it's time to celebrate, you can't go wrong with this!
descriptions.suspicious: A spicy meat stew. The excessive spiciness sets your mouth ablaze... and your stomach too, once you force the meat down your belabored gullet. Now if only there was a large cup of water to put these flames out...
descriptions.delicious: A spicy meat stew. All manner of spices bring out the rich aroma of meat. A well-tuned spiciness awakens your slumbering tastebuds with its touch, and as the meat meets your teeth, its rich juices spill forth, filling your heart with sumptuous joy. Not a drop, you declare, shall be spared. Not one drop.

effectTexts.normal: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 15% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
effectTexts.suspicious: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 10% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
effectTexts.delicious: Increases all party members' CRIT Rate by 20% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
